headline.en: Lin Xia is the perfect date you’re looking for!
headline.zh: 林夏就是你一直在等的那个约会对象！

blurb.en: She’s warm, quick-witted and always has a paperback in her tote — the kind of person who turns a coffee into a three-hour talk about the last book that wrecked her.
blurb.zh: 她温柔又机灵，帆布包里永远揣着一本书。一杯咖啡能被她聊成三小时，从最近让她哭的那本小说，一路聊到楼下哪家面馆最好吃。

blurb.en: You’ll love how curious she is. If you’re into someone who asks the second question, not just the first, Lin Xia’s your kind of vibe.
blurb.zh: 你会喜欢她的好奇心——她不只问第一个问题，还会追问第二个。如果你喜欢认真听你说话的人，林夏就是你的菜。

openers.en: Ask her which book she’d hand a stranger on the subway.
openers.zh: 问问她：如果要在地铁上递给陌生人一本书，她会选哪本？

openers.en: She just got back from Dali — ask about the film roll she hasn’t developed yet.
openers.zh: 她刚从大理回来，问问那卷还没冲洗的胶卷里拍了什么。

text.en: You both want something real this semester, not endless swiping.
text.zh: 你们这学期都想认真认识一个人，而不是一直刷来刷去。

basis.zh: 你们都选了「认真谈恋爱」

text.en: Your humor lands with her: she wrote that she falls for people who make her laugh at dinner.
text.zh: 你的幽默会被她接住：她写过「饭桌上能把我逗笑的人最加分」。

basis.en: Her “first thing your match should know”
basis.zh: ta 的「想让对方知道的第一件事」

headline.en: Zhou Yu is the perfect date you’re looking for!
headline.zh: 周屿就是你一直在等的那个约会对象！

blurb.en: He’s calm, a little nerdy and secretly hilarious — sketches buildings on napkins, runs at 6am, and knows every small livehouse in Haidian.
blurb.zh: 他安静、有点书呆子气，但其实很好笑：会在餐巾纸上画建筑速写，早上 6 点去操场跑步，海淀每家小 livehouse 都门儿清。

blurb.en: You’ll love how steady he is. If you want someone who plans the second date before the first one ends, Zhou Yu’s your kind of vibe.
blurb.zh: 你会喜欢他的稳。如果你想找一个第一次约会还没结束、就开始计划第二次的人，周屿就是你的菜。

openers.en: Ask him which campus building he’d tear down and why.
openers.zh: 问问他：校园里哪栋楼他最想重新设计？为什么？

openers.en: He’s been to 40 livehouse shows this year — ask for the one band you should hear next.
openers.zh: 他今年看了 40 场 livehouse，问问他你下一个该听哪支乐队。

text.en: You both pick “a steady mix” — neither of you wants to rush.
text.zh: 你们都选了「稳稳的节奏」——都不想太快。

basis.en: Both answered “how do u want Ditto to match u”
basis.zh: 你们都回答了「希望怎么帮你匹配」

text.en: He likes people who notice small things; your answers are full of them.
text.zh: 他喜欢会注意小细节的人，而你的回答里全是细节。

basis.zh: ta 的「雷区」+ 你的「第一句话」
